objects.description: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) used the built-in netsh portproxy command to create internal proxies on compromised systems.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)
objects.description_fa: در طول [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051)، [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) از فرمان داخلی netsh portproxy برای ایجاد پراکسی‌های داخلی در سیستم‌های در معرض خطر استفاده کرد.[[[ERVE_1]RES]P (Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)
